title: First working build of the Genlock phone companion app (Android first): talk to the Assistant by dictation and get status updates from the laptop

fields.why: TJ asked to kick off the mobile app build in another session; new codebase and its own goal, separate from the Remote button work here

text: Read mobile/BRIEF.md first: TJ's ask, what exists on the laptop, the parallel Remote button session and its files to avoid, the transport problem (laptop behind NAT; Cloudflare relay or Tailscale), pairing, push. Start with mobile/DESIGN.md and get TJ's OK on transport before building. Android first (Kotlin + Compose suggested), in mobile/.

text: mobile/DESIGN.md written. Finding: bridge needs no Swift changes: tell-*.json into Assistant's voice/<token>/ channel is typed in (collectTells covers all sessions); replies read from Assistant transcript JSONL; status via genlock overview with GENLOCK_APP_* env. Recommends Cloudflare DO relay + LAN debug mode. Waiting on TJ's transport OK (req 1).
Phone must work away from home (on cell data), so connect through a Cloudflare relay both ends dial out to (DESIGN.md option A); same-Wi-Fi only (C) is out
user_said: i need to use this app when im on the road

evidence: mobile/bridge/test/e2e.test.mjs vs wrangler-dev relay: phone 'say' -> tell-*.json '[phone] what is on today?' in Assistant channel; transcript end_turn -> 'reply' on phone; 4/4 pass. Real data: findAssistant found Tally's transcript, status() listed 3 projects. Only mobile/ touched; app/ diffs predate this session (present in startup git status).
e2e test 'a phone without the pairing key is refused': wrong key -> 401, no key -> 401, websocket with wrong key rejected; pass

text: Relay (mobile/relay, Worker+DO, runs locally via npx wrangler dev) + bridge (mobile/bridge: bridge.mjs, pair.mjs, lib.mjs) built; e2e test 4/4. No Swift changes needed. Next: Android app in mobile/android (Compose: Pair/Talk/Status). Then deploy relay (needs wrangler login by TJ).

evidence: cd mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug (JDK 17 from Android Studio jbr) -> exit 0, app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk 16.4MB; installed on Pixel_5_API_33 emulator, paired by deep link, typed 'what is on today' -> tell file '[phone] what is on today' in fake Assistant channel; faked transcript reply shown as Tally bubble; Status tab listed real projects (lunenburgbudgets 18 waiting, agent-genlock sessions)

text: APK builds (JAVA_HOME=Android Studio jbr). Emulator e2e via local wrangler-dev relay + bridge on a fake GENLOCK_HOME: pair, say->tell file, reply bubble, Status with real projects all seen. Left: deploy relay (TJ must run wrangler login), install APK on TJ's phone, run bridge for real, TJ's eye on reqs 4+5; req1 waits on TJ's OK of DESIGN.md (decision 1 recorded transport). Not committed.

Relay deployed: https://genlock-relay.tj-locklainn.workers.dev (no key -> 401 live). APK on TJ's Pixel 10 Pro, paired by adb deep link (QR scanner untested), bridge running in this session's background against real Tally. Waiting on TJ to dictate on cell data + check Status (reqs 4,5). Open: launch agent for bridge (offered), QR scan test, commit.

Icon now the official Genlock mark (adaptive icon generated from assets/logo/genlock-mark.svg, mark 40dp in 108 for circle masks), on TJ's phone. Hardcode sweep: no Tally/relay/user paths in app source; name comes from Assistant/name.txt via bridge. Waiting on TJ's dictation test.

TJ: Google voice dialog stops after ~2s pause, unusable. Replaced with in-app SpeechRecognizer (mobile/android/.../Dictation.kt): on-device recognizer, segmented session on API33+ (30 min), auto-restart fallback, mic toggles to Stop, live partial text in field. Installed on TJ's Pixel; untested by voice (needs TJ).

Dictation dings fixed: Pixel recognizer reads EXTRA_SPEECH_INPUT_MINIMUM_LENGTH_MILLIS as Int and refuses >5 min (measured 300000 ok, 600000+ refused), which had disabled segmented session -> restart loop. Now 5 min Int; on-phone check: 1 session, 0 restarts over ~15s silence. Waiting on TJ's real dictation + Status check (reqs 4,5). Not committed.

TJ: dictation works ('YESS this worked'). Input row redesigned: listening = red outlined Stop at left, Send at right; idle with text = Send right + mic inside field; empty = big mic. Installed on TJ's phone. Still to prove: reqs 1,4,5 (TJ's words), QR scan untested, bridge runs only in this session, nothing committed.

evidence: TJ dictated on his Pixel 10 Pro; bridge log 23:06:32 'reply Hi! Yes, your message from the phone reached me.' sent via live relay; TJ: 'IT WORKED! IT WORKED.'
